The '''Battle of Kalsunor''' was a battle that occurred long before the [[Golden Age of the Sith]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalsunor]] had resisted the [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|Sith Empire's]] many attempts to conquer it, so the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] deposited [[Silooth/Legends|silooths]]&mdash;[[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemically-alterted]] beetle-like creatures&mdash;onto the planet and allowed them to run rampant. The Sith warriors then conquered what remained of the planet.<ref name="DSS" />
